Bayview Hotels -- Cancellation Policy (excerpt, effective 01 Jan 2026):

3.1 Reservations booked under the "Flexible" rate are fully refundable if cancelled at least 24 hours before the scheduled check-in time.
3.2 Reservations booked under the "Saver" rate are non-refundable, except that a full refund will be issued if the cancellation is made within 24 hours of the original booking time ("cooling-off period"), regardless of the check-in date.
3.3 No refunds are issued for cancellations made after check-in, under either rate.
3.4 All cancellations must be submitted through the guest portal or by emailing reservations@bayviewhotels.example; verbal cancellations by phone are not accepted as proof of cancellation.

If that's the same root cause here, hopefully it's a quick fix once someone with the right access actually looks at it, rather than just marking tickets resolved from a dashboard without anyone confirming it with the people who actually reported it.

Rebecca
